qualification: Canonical serial service attachment in the Intel firmware composition

intel.command: make gate-x86_64-userspace SEL4_SDK_VERSION=2.3.0 with the pinned firmware, kernel and initrd arguments retained in x86-virtio-firmware.json
intel.result: PASS exit 0; Linux ring3 initramfs syscall proof verified
scope: Firmware manifest and root descriptor instantiate serial_virt and guest_vmm_primary
VMM must successfully attach as serial client zero before continuing firmware execution
Userspace proof must reject attachment as client one and as the frontend
VMM reads zeroed head/tail words through its root-provisioned large-page mapping
Linux still reaches PID 1 after the attachment IPC and saved VM-entry return is consumed

limitations: No frontend byte producer or registered guest console device exists in this composition yet.
Unexpected service notifications remain fatal; wake handling is not qualified.
The Intel check covers service attachment and own-page reads, not peer-page fault isolation, console traffic or lifecycle teardown.
